title: 有馬記念の後に・変わらない強さ

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the victor is none other than Narita Brian! Again, that's Narita Brian, the Beast!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon really ran her heart out.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but still… Narita Brian is on a completely different level.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: If that was the best Hishi Amazon could do after that whole speech about being "ready," I dunno if she'll ever overtake Brian.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Dang it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I gave it my best shot! My runnin' was nothing short of perfect! And yet…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Argh! This sucks!
In stark contrast to the Shuka Sho, Hishi Amazon leaves the track without any post-race interviews.
Hishi Amazon tells me she's going to pack her stuff and head back early, and then she's gone.
Hishi Amazon is tough, but still…
I know how long she waited for this race… and how high the stakes were.
My worries get the better of me, and I rush back to the academy to go find her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Grrraaaah!
I'm greeted by the sound of a familiar voice the moment I reach campus.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I still don't have what it takes! And so what?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll keep tryin' to catch up to her! I won't stop until I get to her level!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You never know how a race'll turn out till you run it!
She charges up the incline, shouting words of encouragement to herself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nothing out there is impossible right from the get-go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You never know the outcome of a match till you give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Pant… Phew!
She said those very same things to me before I scouted her. It was her straightforward honesty that won me over.
No matter how many hurdles she faces or losses she suffers, she stays determined and unfettered by the fear of failure.
There's only one thing I can say to someone as strong as her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Okay, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Teach, when did you get here?
Narita Brian is sure to show up at the Arima Kinen next year.
I tell Hishi Amazon that we'll win next time, for sure. If anyone can do it, it's her!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Teach, you…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yeah! Thanks!
Afterwards, we discuss our next steps. Considering the aptitude she showed for miles and medium-distance races during the Tiara tour…
We decide to make our next goal the Osaka Hai, followed by the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teach? This could be my ego talking, but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get first place in both of 'em. I won't settle for less!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've gotta step up to the challenge. Otherwise, I won't have a chance against Narita Brian. She's one heck of a beast.
Together, we vow to win first place in both races!
